data.title: Add progress tracking events
data.body:
## Goal

Add explicit events for tracking implementation progress instead of overwriting the body.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `ProgressUpdated { completed: u32, total: u32, note: Option<String> }` event
- [ ] `docket progress ID COMPLETED TOTAL` emits the event
- [ ] `docket progress ID --note "Finished auth module"` adds note
- [ ] `docket show ID` displays progress bar or fraction
- [ ] `docket list` could show progress indicator
- [ ] Progress derived from latest ProgressUpdated event

## Context

Currently progress is tracked by updating checkbox items in the body. This works but has downsides:
- Body gets overwritten frequently
- No event history of progress
- Harder to aggregate/report on

Explicit progress events would enable:
- Progress history over time
- Velocity calculations
- Better visibility in list view

Lower priority: current approach works, this is a nice-to-have.
